title: VoronoiShatter
cue: break any mesh into chunks that fall apart
summary: Voronoi fracture in GDScript: cuts any closed mesh into chunks with inner faces, at load or at the moment of impact, ready to become rigid bodies.
useWhen: Walls, crates, statues, pots, ice, or rocks must break into pieces of their own shape when hit or blown up, and the game should not ship a hand-made broken version of each model.
avoidWhen: The object only vanishes in a puff of particles, the broken version is modelled in Blender, or many objects break in the same frame of a Web game: each cut takes tens of milliseconds.
